prompt: Use Plan mode to prepare a migration plan for a repository where the compatibility target and rollback policy are not yet decided. Inspect the current state, maintain the durable plan note, ask the minimum decision-changing questions, and do not mark the plan ready or modify implementation files while those decisions remain unresolved.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: No implementation file changes or write-capable implementation actions occur while compatibility target and rollback policy remain unresolved.

The checkpoint asks only questions whose answers can materially change compatibility, rollback, sequencing, acceptance, or verification decisions; repository-observable facts are investigated instead of asked back to the user.
The durable plan note records current evidence, resolved decisions, open material decisions, and the provisional dependency structure without presenting unresolved branches as committed work.
The readiness validator remains false and no readiness marker is emitted while either compatibility target or rollback policy can still change the plan.
The plan does not invent a compatibility target, rollback guarantee, or implementation commitment merely to reach a ready state.

evidence: randomized candidate and baseline planning artifacts
